card.summary: Explorer: USD 0 for ever, 10 browser hours a month, 5 concurrent sessions, bring your own proxy

record.interface_detail: a CDP-compatible endpoint for a headless engine
record.tooling: Playwright and Puppeteer over CDP; the Lightpanda binary can also be self-hosted
record.chaining: 10 hours a month of a browser engine that renders without a full Chromium, so the time buys more pages
record.limits_note: Builder is USD 19 a month for 300 hours, then USD 0.08 an hour

free_tier.stated: Explorer: USD 0 for ever, 10 browser hours a month, 5 concurrent sessions, bring your own proxy
free_tier.notes: a purpose-built headless engine rather than a Chromium instance

retention.stated: no session storage is described; the product is a stateless fetch-and-render engine

egress.terms: bring your own proxy; no proxy is included on the free plan

limits.value: 5 concurrent sessions on the free plan; 30 on Builder
10 browser hours a month on the free plan; 300 on Builder

identity_cost.detail: a free signup; no card stated on the pricing page

evidence.proved: Explorer is USD 0 for ever with 10 browser hours a month and 5 concurrent sessions
Builder is USD 19 a month with 300 hours included, then USD 0.08 an hour

record.notes: The only free browser allowance here that recurs monthly with no card, and the engine is lighter than Chromium. The catch is compatibility: it is not a full browser and a site that needs one will not render.

extras.price_arithmetic: 10 hours a month free; 300 h costs USD 19, which is 0.063 an hour
extras.price_note: Builder at USD 19 a month includes 300 browser hours, then USD 0.08 an hour. 730 hours is 19 + 430(0.08) = 53.40.
extras.price_basis: 300 and 730 BROWSER HOURS, not a 2 vCPU shape. A browser host sells minutes of a remote browser, so these rows are not comparable with a sandbox row.

record.binding_note: 10 browser hours a month is the allowance, and the engine's compatibility is the second wall
